name: A Crew Under Fire
objectiveText: Defend Captain Vanessa Beltis , her crew and the Horizon Scout's passengers against the naga attack. Captain Vanessa Beltis must survive.   Protect Captain Vanessa Beltis from the naga attack  ( 1 )

objectiveRows.text: Protect Captain Vanessa Beltis from the naga attack

comments.body: WORST quest ever
replies: You CAN get up to the gnome shack from the water... there's a little bit of a slope that will make it reachable. Just keep trying to find it

yes.. true there is a way up...
head the the end of the cove to the east of the Gnome building... staart jumping first north then west the edge hug and quick jump west towards the buidling ... the soil changes colour.. and it took me several attempt ^^' -

still a pain to climb

the more obvious looking path to the west of the building didn't seem to work for me. ^^'

hmm testing another pain .. go to the south point of the outcropping .. there is an easier path up on the west side of it ... jump east then north up.
This quest is still a one and done (repeatable). Pretty funny.

comments.body: "Greetings --- I am Game Master ---. This quest is not fully impelemented and more will be added eventually. Please also bear in mind the quest is repeatable so if you wish to do so you can do it again."
After I did this quest and only got 600xp I started it again and let everybody get slaughtered by the Naga -- then I felt better.

STILL unfinished or something. I was doing the Asharite quest when I fell down a gap. I ressed and found this q - thought I would do it for fun and to see what reward I would get. 
Horribly disappointed I didn't get anything at all - 600XP when at level cap = biggest waste of time ever. 
And a waste of runecloth ;)
If it isn't finished, why can't they just pick some random green weapon and have that as reward or something? Or just junk the quest all together until it is done?
U can't even loot the naga!

The final wave the crew decided not to help, so I ran far enough away to be out of combat and then went back and waited for the naga to despawn (they just stood around and didn’t attack the crew) as soon as they did I got credit for a complete quest. 

She mentioned at the end to speak to other crew members (reading the other threads I found out this step is not implemented at the moment) these were the crew members I could find … none of them spoke to me, though 

Second Mate Shandril – on the island watching over the debris 
Roland Geardabbler – In sunken ship 
Horizon Scout First Mate – In sunken ship 
Horizon Scout Engineer – In sunken ship 
Horizon Scout Cook – In sunken ship 
Horizon Scout Crewman – 7 one on shore before the valley leading to the Captain and six more at her side. 
Captain Vanessa Beltis 
Patrick Mills – Fights beside the captain 
Alexandra Blazen – Fights beside the captain 
Lindros – Fights beside the captain
2019, the relaunch of classic and blizzard decided to keep this broken quest. Still 600xp and nothing. Great bait.
replies: Hey I can see two reasons to do this quest..

They never finished it because I mean lets be real, its Azhara baby. Supposedly the data for this quest chain was programmed but they never finished/implemented it. I guess it was repeatable so players wouldn't get flagged for completing it once Blizzard (never) finished the quest.

comments.body: I found these guys by accident while exploring the beaches and the quest does the same thing at lvl58. Very, very easy for a mage - just put up mana shield (frost ward helps too, but isn't necessary because they die so fast) and nova them right at the little gate where the crew is hiding behind. About 5 or so arcane explosions was enough to finish off each wave of the naga, so plenty of time between waves to refuel mana. It's disappointing that you can't loot them because soo many corpses. >_>
At this time, this quest is bugged. You cannot loot any of the naga, so you can't grind them for Golden Pearls.
Nothing, zip, nada after this patch either. The quest is repeatable though, my guess is some broken handle or trigger. That, or they just haven't made the rest of the quests yet.
iv done it like 5 minutes ago with my 60 lvl character, gained 600 xp, no gold whatsoever and its still repeatable :) but hey , a least the pirates are safe!

Still as others have said:

Crew doesn't help fight last wave.

Minimal XP, no reward.

Repeatable.

No reason to do this unless you're feeling completionist, but even then, it doesn't get marked as completed.

According to Blizzard GM:

The issue reported above is not considered to be "broken" and should be 
functioning normally. If you feel that the functionality should be 
different, then please visit the Suggestion Forum 
(http://forums.worldofwarcraft.com/board.aspx?fn=wow-suggestions) and 
post a suggestion. These forums are regularly monitored by the World of 
Warcraft development team.

It seems that this quest is functioning normal.  It just "seems" buggy to everyone but the GM.

It seems this quest is unfinished. The Captain hints at being able to talk to her crew for further quests once this quest is completed, but none of them have a thing to say. 

And yes, the quest is repeatable. Very fun quest, too bad it's unfinished and so hard to get to.
"Soloed" this quest at level 50 (with the help of her crew).  Too bad, still only 600xp *groan*.

I got lost swimming around the continent and ended up in their camp, I wandered here thinking I had missed something (lvl57 quest only 600Xp) but I guess not. 
Did it twice and didn't notice the crew not helping the first time when I had help from my buddy, second time he was afk and I got stomped when the crew didnt help me (lvl 54 trying to solo 5 lvl 49 Naga). 
Repeatable is ok I guess and if they really dont kill the crew and despawn at the last wave and you still get xp then its even easier because as long as the crew is helping you its easy. Only that last wave when you have to solo is hard.

Actual XP Gained: At lvl 54 I was getting 19-20xp for each naga (I was in a group of 2) 4-5 waves of 5 plus the 600 for quest complete, you should get about 1000-1200xp total for about 5-10 minutes of little work. Not too bad but still not great and would be nice if you could loot the naga that attack.

20 May 2007

Soloed with 52 hunter and pet (plus crew).

Minimal mob XP, no completion XP, repeatable.

i.e. No change since April.

Out visting Duke Hydraxis and thought i would check on this quest.  You can still do the battle, but none of the passengers on shore or in the wreck respond even now after 2.0 patch.  May give xp but not to me at 60.  I guess i will check back again after BC comes out.

I soloed this at 50 as a prot-speced Paladin, and I would imagine other classes who can heal would be able to do alright at the lower levels. It's a lot of work for a sum total of about 1k XP, I could just kill three things somewhere else in about a minute and a half to get the same XP, with a lot less risk.

As others have said, after several waves the crew just start standing there and stop fighting.

At this point, just stand way back so you don`t get aggro (I had Shadowmeld so I`m not sure if you could do it otherwise).  The naga will stop at the crew and just kinda stand there.

A few minutes later they`ll despawn and you`ll get completion credit.

Too bad there`s no rewards.
best warlocks shard gathering place in the game, shadowbolt->souldrain. let the npc's do the rest.

It's disappointing to learn that the devs haven't fixed this quest. You could probably do it as a 60 of some sort but why would you? Maybe there's an authenticity thing going on. Keep the broken parts because they're part of the original experience? I guess we could make that theoretical argument but how many people would prefer authenticity and "original design" to what could have been a tough but possible (and thus more interesting) quest?

Everything that comes is a 48-50 non-elite.  A 57 would easily solo it, especially since the npc crew helps fight.

...Except the last fight.  They don't seem to help as of patch 1.8.

I dont think blizz expected people to find this quest yet. I just stumbled across these guys after falling off a cliff and dying right next to them. I was hoping for some great reward since it was a quest that wasn't in a normal area and hard to get to, but since im 60 I got nothing except the option to do it again. too bad.
I did this level 57 quest for Nothing! No reward at all. "Working Properly" my ass.

Okay - as posted above - on their last attack, you will notice that the crew does nothing (some may even have died during an earlier wave).

Do pull way back and only 1 will come in to dispatch at your leisure.  However, you will have to kill the rest for the quest to complete.

Location again is 53,87 - and if you come from shore at 49,91 there is a lone scout there.

At the end she says: 
I would ask you to speak to any surviving passengers from the Horizon Scout. Some of them had business in the area, and may have a request or two of you if you're willing. 

not true - yet - I thought maybe it had something to do with the 3 other named (Lindros, Patrick Mills, Alexandra Blazen) staying alive.  So I did it a second time - the weird thing is that even post BC, I got zero experience from either time at lvl 60.
Their wreck is not easy to find along the far southern coast of Azshara at @ 45x90.

02/04/2007  the quest is still active ...I compleated this one..it is repeatable but not with a blue "?" after compleating the quest the gold "!" comes back. at lvl 49 only "19" xp per kill when i still had bonus xp rested bonus was 8xp  O.O  strange goings on here with this quest!
Soloed it (51 Mage) and got 600xp. Not worth the time.

I found this quest as well, and personally use it as a Role-play quest to test small groups of applicants and those in the guild who want to lead patrol groups in role-play.

Since this quest is repetable it works well for that purpose with a small reward for completing it.

I did it with my paladin 49 I didn't receive any reward..no exp lol :P

In my opinion there's a secret on this quets XD
replies:
I raised the question via an in-game ticket and received an e-mail.  Like you - I was thinking maybe there was a 'right' thing to do.

Maybe all the named sailors have to stay alive? 
Maybe you have to complete the quest 7 times? 
ETC.  etc.  etc.

E-mail response: 

[div]We are aware of the situation you reported, and we are currently working on a solution. [/div]
Pretty much Blizzard's standard (automated) response to these things.  They've been [b]currently working on[/b] it for a very long time!

comments.body: Now the quest is repeatable...lol.  600 exp what a joke.  Atleast it's easy as hell.

Only gave me 600xp soloing it ( Rogue 56 ), and immediately let me take the quest again.

Grrrr

probably not worth your time. no followups, nothing accomplished by doing it, and the reward is pretty small if you're high enough to solo it.

when you complete it, she says you should talk to the surviving members for more jobs, but none of them have anything to say. probably to be added later.

a tip for rogues: you can move up in the valley around the corner, and use distract to stop half the group on their way. so you can just fight half of each wave at a time. I wouldn't recommend sap though, or they all come for you. and it's hard for the crewmen to get them off.

Just finished this on my level 52 hunter, the trick to make sure you get heals from the npc's as well as the pally devotion armor buff is to turn your pvp flag on! (this also works in ZF doing the stair event with SGT Bly). It was very easy I laid an explosive trap before each wave sent my pet, cast volley, then multi-shot and FD when I had aggro. All NPC's lived & I got 600xp for finishing the quest. The Captain told me to talk to her crew and passengers as they might have request for me to do something for them, but you cannot talk to anyone but her.
